note: Row of about 14 angled pull-through RV pads at the south edge of the Dakota Sioux Casino & Hotel parking lot, off I-29 exit 185 near Watertown (16415 Sioux Conifer Rd). Register at the hotel front desk; hotel WiFi reaches the pads. Closed fall and winter. No tent camping. --Claude
summary: Operator page: $25 + tax, water + 20/30/50 A, rigs to 50 ft, closed fall/winter, register at the hotel. Fees, hookups and max length confirmed manual; note trimmed of repeated hookups/length. Gate passes ($25). Google rating found is the casino's (3.9/940), not the RV park's. Pin, phone, website fine; not waterfront confirmed.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: posted $25/night + tax (operator page, read 2026-11-22) - passes the $50 gate. Presence: operator page live + phone (605) 884-1700. Not long-stay in character (nightly only, no weekly/monthly offered). Google: the only listing is the casino's, 'Dakota Sioux Casino & Hotel' 3.9 over 940 reviews - shared with the casino and hotel, so not the campground's alone; no separate RV-park listing found. RV Life (per stored inclusion_evidence) 4.5 over 14.

CASINO-LOT CHECK: imagery shows a dedicated set of ~14 angled pull-through pads with grass islands south of the parking lot, not RV parking along the lot - kept as a developed RV park (as the stored evidence says).
OWNERSHIP: the casino is the Sisseton-Wahpeton Oyate's tribal enterprise; a commercial RV park on it stays `private` (no change proposed).
SEASON: page gives no dates ('closed for the fall and winter seasons'); stored derived year_round false left as is.
BOOKING: page says only to register at the hotel / call (605) 884-1700; no reservation statement, booking group left absent.

PHONE 605-884-1700 matches the page's registration number (Google shows the casino's (800) 658-4717). WEBSITE live. PIN fine (on the pads). Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed (fields; a pothole ~300 m E).
